# BootstrapConfig { #qte.bootstrap.BootstrapConfig }

```python
bootstrap.BootstrapConfig()
```

Configuration for the bootstrap.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                       | Default    |
|-----------|--------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| n_iter    | int    | Number of bootstrap replications. | _required_ |
| seed      | int    |                                   | _required_ |
| n_workers | int    | Number of worker threads.         | _required_ |
